newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah kills Israeli soldier in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah kills Israeli soldier in south Lebanon.

text.p: An Israeli soldier was killed in fighting with pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas in south Lebanon on Sunday, Israeli-backed militia sources said.

In retaliation, Israeli planes launched three separate raids on Hizbollah positions in the area. Israeli artillery also engaged the guerrillas in duels in which three Lebanese civilians, including two boys, were wounded.
The soldier was wounded in Sojoud area on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone and later died of his wounds.
In Jerusalem, an army spokesman said that Israeli army officer Major Nadav Milo, 24, was killed in a clash between soldiers and guerrillas in the eastern sector of the zone.
He was the 12th Israeli soldier to be killed in Lebanon this year. Last year, 27 Israeli soldiers died in Lebanon.
In Beirut, a Hizbollah spokesman claimed responsibility for the attack and said several Israeli soldiers were killed.
"The Islamic resistance attacked an Israeli unit in Sojoud and several Zionist soldiers were killed and several were wounded," he said.
"Israeli helicopters tried to rescue the injured but they failed. There is heavy fighting and the Israeli helicopters have carried out many raids on Sojoud," the spokesman added.
He added that there were no Hizbollah casualties in the fighting and vowed that the group would continue attacks against Israeli soldiers.
"We will continue carrying out attacks against the Zionists," said the spokesman.

Shortly after the attack, Israeli planes fired a total of 10 rockets at two different sectors of Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge, used by Hizbollah guerrillas as a launching pad for attacks on the occupation zone, witnesses said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the three raids, which raised to 45 the number of Israeli air assaults on Lebanon this year.
In Jerusalem, an army spokesman confirmed the raids and said "the targets that were hit were used as firing positions of the terrorists. The pilots reported accurate hits on the targets".
Witnesses said that by late afternoon the fighting had subsided except for random Israeli shelling of Iqlim al-Toufah.
Hizbollah guerrillas are fighting to oust Israeli troops and their local militia allies from the 15-km (nine-mile)-wide border zone they hold in south Lebanon.
